registration_type.label: GST registration type
registration_type.description: Your GST registration type. Only regular registration is supported now.

prices_include_gst.label: Prices include GST
prices_include_gst.description: Turn on if the prices you enter already include GST.

component_rounding.label: Rounding of tax amounts
component_rounding.description: How each tax amount is rounded to the paisa.

hsn_min_digits.label: Minimum HSN code length
hsn_min_digits.description: Minimum HSN code length required on products.

timing.label: When to create the tax invoice
timing.description: When the tax invoice is created: when goods are dispatched (for the packed quantity), or when the order or backorder is accepted.

round_to_rupee.label: Round invoice totals to the rupee
round_to_rupee.description: Round invoice totals to the nearest rupee with a round-off line.

round_off_method.label: How to round to the rupee
round_off_method.description: How the invoice total is rounded to the rupee.

default_payment_terms_days.label: Default credit days
default_payment_terms_days.description: Default credit days for new retailers (each retailer can differ).

acceptance_mode.label: Order acceptance
acceptance_mode.description: Accept new orders yourself, or automatically when they pass all checks.

send_confirmation_on_accept.label: Send Order Confirmation on acceptance
send_confirmation_on_accept.description: Send the retailer an Order Confirmation (items, prices, tax estimate) when you accept an order.

min_order_value.label: Minimum order value
min_order_value.description: Smallest order value a retailer can place. Backordered items count.

min_order_value_basis.label: Minimum order value includes GST?
min_order_value_basis.description: Whether the minimum order value includes GST.

pre_acceptance_edit_mode.label: Changes before acceptance
pre_acceptance_edit_mode.description: What your team can change before accepting: only reduce or remove items, or also add items and increase quantities. The retailer is always notified.

options.FULL_EDIT: Also add items and increase quantities

staff_can_place_on_behalf.label: Staff can order for retailers
staff_can_place_on_behalf.description: Allow your staff (for example salesmen) to place orders for retailers.

sales_visibility.label: What sales staff can see
sales_visibility.description: Which orders and retailers sales staff can see.

pending_alert_hours.label: Alert for orders waiting (hours)
pending_alert_hours.description: Show a dashboard alert for orders not accepted within this many hours.

insufficient_stock_action.label: When stock runs short (backorders off)
insufficient_stock_action.description: When backorders are off and stock runs short at checkout: stop the order and show what's short, or place only the in-stock part.

options.FAIL: Stop the order and show what's short

show_exact_quantity.label: Show exact stock to retailers
show_exact_quantity.description: Show retailers the exact quantity in stock (otherwise only "In stock" or "Low stock").

show_low_stock_label.label: Show a "Low stock" label
show_low_stock_label.description: Show a "Low stock" label to retailers when stock is at or below the reorder level.

show_out_of_stock_in_shop.label: Show out-of-stock products to shops
show_out_of_stock_in_shop.description: Shops see products with no stock, marked "Out of stock". Turn off to hide them until stock arrives. Only matters when backorders are off.

cost_method.label: How goods receipts change the cost price
cost_method.description: When you receive goods with a cost, the product's cost price can follow the average of your stock and the new bill, the latest bill, or stay as you set it. You can always change a cost price by hand.

options.WEIGHTED_AVERAGE: Average of stock and new bill

enabled.label: Allow backorders
enabled.description: Let retailers order more than is in stock; the rest is sent when stock arrives.

allocation_mode.label: Allocating arriving stock to backorders
allocation_mode.description: When stock arrives, confirm each backorder allocation yourself, or allocate automatically (oldest orders first).

billing_price.label: Price for backordered items
billing_price.description: Price for backordered items sent later: the price when ordered, or today's price.

breach_action.label: When a credit limit would be exceeded
breach_action.description: When an order would exceed a retailer's credit limit: hold it for approval, or refuse it.

hold_reserves_stock.label: Reserve stock for orders on credit hold
hold_reserves_stock.description: Keep stock reserved for orders waiting for credit approval.

block_overdue_after_days.label: Treat as over limit when overdue by (days)
block_overdue_after_days.description: Treat a retailer as over limit when any invoice is overdue by more than this many days.

hold_advances.label: Keep extra payments as credit
hold_advances.description: Keep extra money paid by a retailer as credit and use it for their next invoices.

cheque_credit_timing.label: When a cheque counts as paid
cheque_credit_timing.description: Credit a cheque to the retailer's account when received (reversed automatically if it bounces) or only when it clears.

require_staff_2fa.label: Require two-step verification for staff
require_staff_2fa.description: Require every staff member to set up two-step verification (an authenticator app) before they can sign in.

hsn_rate_hints_enabled.label: Suggest GST rates from HSN codes
hsn_rate_hints_enabled.description: Suggest GST rates from the HSN hint table on product forms and imports.

default_invoice_prefix.label: Default invoice prefix
default_invoice_prefix.description: Prefix proposed when a tenant's first invoice series is created.

impersonation_session_minutes.label: Support session length (minutes)
impersonation_session_minutes.description: Maximum length of a support impersonation session.

login_lockout_threshold.label: Failed sign-ins before locking
login_lockout_threshold.description: Consecutive failed sign-ins before an account is locked.

login_lockout_minutes.label: Lock duration (minutes)
login_lockout_minutes.description: How long a locked account stays locked.

login_rate_per_ip_per_minute.label: Sign-in attempts per IP per minute
login_rate_per_ip_per_minute.description: Sign-in attempts allowed per minute from one IP address (generous: many mobile users share an IP).

login_rate_per_email_per_minute.label: Sign-in attempts per email per minute
login_rate_per_email_per_minute.description: Sign-in attempts allowed per minute for one email address.

otp_rate_per_phone_per_10_minutes.label: Codes per phone per 10 minutes
otp_rate_per_phone_per_10_minutes.description: OTP codes that can be requested for one phone number in 10 minutes.

otp_rate_per_ip_per_hour.label: Codes per IP per hour
otp_rate_per_ip_per_hour.description: OTP codes that can be requested from one IP address per hour (generous: many mobile users share an IP).

password_reset_per_email_per_hour.label: Password reset emails per address per hour
password_reset_per_email_per_hour.description: Password reset emails that can be requested for one email address per hour.

otp_max_verify_attempts.label: Wrong codes allowed
otp_max_verify_attempts.description: Wrong codes allowed before an OTP stops working.

blocked_can_sign_in.label: Shops on hold can sign in
blocked_can_sign_in.description: Shops you put on hold can still sign in and see their account, but can't order. Turn off to stop them signing in.

show_own_brand_badge.label: Own-brand badge in the shop
show_own_brand_badge.description: Show an "own brand" badge on your own-brand products in the shop.

discounts_on_special_prices.label: Discounts on special prices
discounts_on_special_prices.description: Apply discount rules on top of a shop's special prices. Turn off to treat a special price as the final price.

discount_combination.label: When several discounts apply
discount_combination.description: How discounts combine when more than one applies to a product. The total never exceeds the price, and shops see only the total saving.

options.SEQUENTIAL: Apply one after another, most specific first (10% then 5% = 14.5%)

imports.title: Import from Excel
imports.description: Add or update many products or retailers at once. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

kindHint.PRODUCTS: Codes, names, prices, GST, categories and brands.
kindHint.RETAILERS: Shops with mobile numbers, GSTIN, addresses and price lists.
kindHint.SPECIAL_PRICES: One price per shop and product. Shops by mobile number or code.
kindHint.PRICE_LIST_ITEMS: Prices on your price lists, by list name and product code.
kindHint.DISCOUNT_RULES: Discounts by product, brand or category, for all shops, a price list or one shop; one row per quantity slab.
kindHint.OPENING_STOCK: How much of each product you have, by product code; optionally its cost. The whole file becomes one stock adjustment.

imports.modeTitle: What should happen to rows that already exist?

modeHint.ADD_ONLY: New rows are added. Rows that already exist are reported as errors and nothing about them changes.
modeHint.ADD_OR_UPDATE: New rows are added and existing ones are updated. Only the columns in your file change; a blank cell means “no change”. You'll see every change before anything is saved.
modeHint.STOCK_ADD: Each quantity is added to what is in stock now.
modeHint.STOCK_SET: Stock becomes exactly the quantity in the file (for example after a count). You'll see the old and new stock of every product before anything is saved.

form.welcomeNote: A welcome message with the sign-in link is sent to the mobile number.

detail.resendBody: It goes to {mobile} with the sign-in link.
detail.putOnHoldBody: They can't place orders while on hold. Your settings decide whether they can still sign in and browse.
detail.deleteBody: The shop can no longer sign in. Past orders and invoices keep it.
detail.addDiscount: Add a discount for this shop

credit.title: Credit
credit.editBody: Changes are recorded in the audit log.

prices.title: What this shop pays
prices.description: Today's price for each product at its minimum order quantity, worked out by the server exactly as the shop sees it.
prices.emptyTitle: No products the shop can buy yet
prices.emptyBody: Products need to be active and have a GST rate in effect.

lists.title: Price lists
lists.description: Give groups of shops their own prices. Products not on a shop's list use the standard price.
lists.name: Name
lists.deleteBody: Only lists that no shop or discount uses can be deleted.
lists.emptyBody: Every shop pays the standard prices until you add a price list and assign shops to it.

items.summary: {items, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} · {shops, plural, one {# shop} other {# shops}}
items.explain: Shops on this list pay these prices. Products not listed here use the standard price. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
items.removeBody: Shops on this list will pay the standard price for it.
items.noMatchTitle: No products on this list match
items.emptyTitle: No products on this list yet
items.emptyBody: Add products and their prices for this group of shops.
items.noShops: No shops use this list yet.

special.title: Special prices
special.description: A price for one shop and one product. It comes before any price list and the standard price.
special.priceHint: The price this shop pays for one unit.
special.removeBody: The shop will pay its price-list or standard price again.
special.emptyBody: Use special prices for deals agreed with one shop.

discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.description: Automatic discounts by product, category or brand, for all shops or some.
discounts.name: Name
discounts.emptyBody: Shops see discounts automatically on their prices.
discounts.useSlabsHint: For example 5% from 12 units and 10% from 24.
discounts.datesHint: Leave empty for no limit. Both days are included.
discounts.bestRuleNote: When several discounts apply to a product, a shop gets only the biggest one; discounts are never added together.

grid.title: Discounts for {shop}
grid.description: Set this shop's own discount on each product. The net price comes from the server as you type; nothing changes until you save.
grid.emptyBody: Products need to be active and have a GST rate in effect.
grid.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
grid.saved: {count, plural, one {# discount saved} other {# discounts saved}}.
grid.note: Empty or 0 removes the shop's discount on a product. Discounts with quantity slabs or dates are shown as “Also:” and edited on their own page.

copy.title: Copy pricing to {shop}
copy.description: Copies the price list, special prices and this-shop-only discounts. You'll see every change before anything is copied.
copy.modeTitle: What happens to this shop's own pricing?

modeHint.REPLACE: This shop's special prices and shop-only discounts are removed first, so it ends up exactly like the other shop.
modeHint.ADD: The other shop's pricing is added. Where both have a special price for a product, the other shop's is used.

adjust.title: Change prices on {list} by a percentage
adjust.description: Changes the list prices of one brand or category. You'll see every change before anything is saved.
adjust.percentHint: For example 5 for +5%, or -3 for a 3% cut.
adjust.includeMissing: Also add the products that aren't on this list yet
adjust.includeMissingHint: They start from the standard price.
adjust.summary: {count, plural, one {# price} other {# prices}} will change{added, plural, =0 {} one { (# new on the list)} other { (# new on the list)}}.
adjust.done: {count, plural, one {# price updated} other {# prices updated}}.

report.title: Shop pricing
report.description: Shops with their own special prices or discounts, so nothing stays hidden.
report.freeBody: A ₹0 price, or discounts that reach the whole price. Shops don't see these products.
report.emptyTitle: No shop has its own pricing
report.emptyBody: Special prices and shop-only discounts will show up here.
report.freeNote: Free products are worked out from today's prices and discounts, including discounts that add up to the whole price.

shop.homeBody: Search, tap Add, and place your order in a few taps.
shop.onHold: Your account is on hold. Please contact your distributor.
shop.searchHint: Type a product name or brand.
shop.noMatchBody: Check the spelling or try a shorter word.
shop.noProductsBody: Your distributor hasn't added products here yet.
shop.categoryGoneBody: It may have been moved or emptied.

product.goneBody: It may be out of the catalog for now.

order.cantOrder: Not available to order right now.

home.skipped: {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} can't be ordered any more: {names}
home.noOrdersBody: Search or pick a category to place your first order.
home.summary: Open orders: {open} · Items waiting for stock: {waiting}

orders.title: Orders
orders.placedBody: Your distributor has it. You'll see here when it's accepted and sent.
orders.onHold: This order is over your credit limit. Your distributor will approve it before accepting.
orders.skipped: {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} can't be ordered any more and were left out.
orders.cancelBody: Your distributor hasn't accepted it yet, so nothing has been sent.
orders.cancelWaitingBody: The {qty} still waiting for stock won't be sent.
orders.priceUp: The price went up from {before} to {now}. You can decline it until it's packed.
orders.declineBody: It won't be sent, and you won't pay for it.

live.order_short_supplied: Some items of order {number} will come later.
live.backorder_allocated: Items you were waiting for (order {number}) are on their way.
live.backorder_cancelled: Waiting items of order {number} were cancelled.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.emptyBody: Search for products or pick a category, then tap Add.
cart.gone: This product can't be ordered any more. It will be left out.
cart.laterBody: These are out of stock now. We'll send them as soon as stock arrives; you can cancel them any time before then.
cart.shortBody: Your distributor doesn't take orders for more than is in stock.
cart.estimate: The final amount is on your invoice.
cart.needsApproval: This order is over your credit limit. Your distributor will approve it before accepting.
cart.unknownOutcome: The connection dropped while placing your order. Tap Try again: we'll check first, so it can't be placed twice.
cart.offline: No connection. Tap Try again when you're back online. Your order hasn't been placed twice.

problems.PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: This product can't be ordered right now. Remove it to continue.
problems.NOT_ENOUGH_STOCK: Only {qty} {unit} in stock. Lower the quantity to continue.
problems.PARTLY_AVAILABLE: Only {qty} {unit} in stock: the rest won't be sent.
problems.RETAILER_ON_HOLD: Your account is on hold. Please contact your distributor.
problems.CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: This order is over your credit limit ({amount} available). Please pay your dues or contact your distributor.
problems.OTHER: Something in your cart needs a change.

overview.title: Stock
overview.description: What you have, what is reserved for orders and what needs restocking.
overview.awaitingCost: {count, plural, one {# goods receipt is} other {# goods receipts are}} waiting for costs.
overview.noMatchBody: Try another search or clear the filters.
overview.emptyBody: Add products first; their stock appears here.

detail.reorderHelp: You'll get a low-stock alert when the available stock falls to this level.

movements.title: Stock movements
movements.description: Every change to stock, newest first. Movements are never edited; corrections are new movements.
movements.emptyBody: Receiving goods and adjustments show up here.

scan.label: Scan or search a product
scan.placeholder: Scan a barcode or type a name or code
scan.linkPlaceholder: Search the product for this barcode
scan.cameraHelp: Point the camera at the barcode. It is read automatically.
scan.cameraNeedsHttps: The camera only works on a secure (https) connection. Type the code, or use a USB or Bluetooth scanner.
scan.cameraDenied: The camera couldn't be opened. Allow camera access for this site, or type the code.
scan.cameraUnsupported: This browser can't read barcodes with the camera. Type the code, or use a scanner.
scan.notFound: No product has the barcode or code {code}.
scan.link: Link this barcode to a product
scan.linkingHelp: Choose the product that has barcode {code}. It will be saved on the product.

receipts.title: Goods received
receipts.description: Receipts of goods from suppliers. Posting one adds the stock at once.
receipts.costPending: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} waiting for cost
receipts.noneAwaitingBody: Every posted receipt has its costs.
receipts.emptyBody: Receive goods when a supplier's delivery arrives.

receipt.newBody: Scan or search each product, enter what arrived, then post to add it to stock.
receipt.noCostNote: Costs are added later by someone who manages costs.
receipt.emptyLines: No products yet. Scan a barcode or search above.
receipt.postTitle: Post this receipt ({count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}})?
receipt.postBody: The stock goes up now. A posted receipt can't be changed; fix a mistake with a stock adjustment.
receipt.deleteBody: Nothing was added to stock yet.
receipt.linesPending: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} waiting for cost
receipt.completeHelp: Enter the cost from the supplier's bill, before GST. Quantities don't change.
receipt.saveCosts: {count, plural, =0 {Save costs} one {Save # cost} other {Save # costs}}
receipt.costsSaved: {count, plural, one {# cost saved} other {# costs saved}}

adjustment.newBody: Correct stock after a count, damage or loss. Every adjustment keeps its reason and note.
adjustment.noteHint: Required. For example: "Monthly count, rack B".
adjustment.emptyLines: No products yet. Scan a barcode or search above.
adjustment.save: {count, plural, =0 {Save adjustment} one {Save adjustment (# product)} other {Save adjustment (# products)}}
adjustment.savedWithUnchanged: {number} saved. {count, plural, one {# count matched} other {# counts matched}} the stock, so nothing changed there.

adjustments.title: Stock adjustments
adjustments.description: Corrections to stock with their reasons. Adjustments can't be edited; a mistake is fixed with another adjustment.
adjustments.emptyBody: Adjust stock after a count, or when goods are damaged or lost.

alerts.title: Stock alerts
alerts.description: Products that are low, out of stock or have shops waiting. Alerts close by themselves when stock comes back.
alerts.noneOpenBody: Everything is above its reorder level.

reports.indexDescription: More reports (sales, receivables) come with ordering and billing.
reports.noReportsBody: Ask the owner if you need stock reports.
reports.lowDescription: Products at or below their reorder level, with how much you are short.
reports.valuationDescription: What your stock is worth at cost price, before GST, by category and brand.
reports.withoutReorder: {count, plural, one {# active product has} other {# active products have}} no reorder level, so they never show as low.
reports.noLowBody: Every product with a reorder level has more than that in stock.
reports.missingNote: Products without a cost price are not in the totals. Tap the count to see them.
reports.missingTitle: Products in stock without a cost price
reports.noStockBody: Products appear here once they are in stock.
reports.valuationNoAccess: This report shows costs, so it needs cost access. Ask the owner if you need it.

orderStatus.toFollow: {count, plural, one {# item to follow} other {# items to follow}}

live.onHold: Order {number} from {shop} is over the credit limit and needs approval
live.proposed: Stock arrived for backorders of order {number}
live.cancelled: Order {number} was cancelled by the shop

board.title: Orders
board.description: New orders first. Accept, pack and dispatch from each order.
board.emptyBody: Orders from your shops appear here as soon as they're placed.
board.accepted: {count, plural, one {# order accepted} other {# orders accepted}}
board.selectPage: Select all orders on this page

detail.editBody: Lower a quantity, or set it to 0 to remove the item. The shop is told.
detail.rejectBody: Everything held for it is released.
detail.approveTitle: Approve order {number} over the credit limit?
detail.approveBody: You approve {total}, including items waiting for stock.
detail.cancelBody: Everything not yet dispatched is released.
detail.onHold: This order is over the shop's credit limit and waits for someone who manages credit.
detail.approvedOverLimit: Approved over the credit limit for {amount}. Its waiting items aren't held back by the limit.
detail.cancelWaitingBody: The {qty} waiting for stock won't be sent. The shop is told.

shipment.packBody: Enter what you packed. Anything short waits for stock again (or is cancelled, as your settings say).
shipment.dispatchBody: Vehicle and transport details are optional.

backorders.title: Backorders
backorders.description: Orders waiting for stock, oldest first. Arriving stock is offered to them automatically.
backorders.proposalsBody: Stock that arrived is held for these orders. Confirm to create the shipment, or reject to offer it to the next order.
backorders.confirmed: {count, plural, one {# allocation confirmed} other {# allocations confirmed}}
backorders.noneWaiting: No orders are waiting for stock
backorders.noneWaitingBody: Items shops order when you're out of stock appear here.
backorders.nothingWaiting: Nothing is waiting for this product
backorders.waitingBody: Oldest first. Blocked shops never get stock.
backorders.allocated: {count, plural, one {# allocation made} other {# allocations made}}
backorders.overLimitOverride: Give a reason to allocate anyway (it's recorded).
backorders.overLimitAsk: Someone who manages credit can allocate it.

onBehalf.title: Order for a shop
onBehalf.description: Your own cart for the shop, at the shop's prices. The order says it was placed by you.
onBehalf.pricesNote: The cart shows this shop's prices.
onBehalf.cartEmpty: Search for products to add them.
onBehalf.needsApproval: This order is over the shop's credit limit; it will wait for approval.

problems.PARTLY_AVAILABLE: Only {qty} {unit} in stock: the rest won't be sent.
problems.CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Over the shop's credit limit ({amount} available).
problems.OTHER: Something in the cart needs a change.
